title: How a Godly Man Chooses the Brothers Who'll Actually Tell Him the Truth
caption:
Most men never actually choose their brothers. They just drift into whoever's closest and call it community.

A godly man picks on purpose. He picks the guy who'll say the hard thing, not the one who agrees with everything. He gives permission to be called out before he's ever fallen, not after.

Proximity beats a group chat every time. Find the men who have your actual Tuesday, not just your number.
